title: Automated intake gateway with sample-based smoke tests and deterministic pinflow
creator: Priya Nair
description: Objective: Build an end-to-end automated intake gateway that accepts new community model weights, runs deterministic conversion and compatibility checks, executes a small sample-based smoke test harness (generation + embedding parity + KV-cache replay), and then creates a versioned pin with a published performance profile in the model catalog. This ticket covers the orchestration layer, light-weight deterministic validators, and the policy path to auto-publish 'candidate' profiles for manual QA to approve. Background: We continue to get a steady stream of community weights in different packaging (transformers, safetensors, GGUF) and inconsistent tokenizers. Current onboarding is manual and slow; this automation will reduce time-to-serving and catch regressions earlier.
acceptance_criteria: New weight upload triggers the intake gateway and returns a tracking ID within 30s
Conversion step supports the four canonical input formats (transformers, safetensors, GGUF, ONNX) and records the conversion artifact hash
Tokenizer parity check passes for at least 95% of sample prompts or the model is flagged for tokenization review
Deterministic smoke tests (n=10 prompts) run within a 5-minute job budget and report latency percentiles and token-level diffs
KV-cache replay test validates that cached prefix generation matches non-cached baseline for at least 90% of tokens
Automatic candidate profile is published to the staging catalog (with CPU/GPU perf numbers) but remains in candidate state until manual QA approve/reject
Successful pin commit writes a pinned model version entry and a link to the conversion artifact and profile in the catalog
Failures emit structured alerts to #model-onboarding with triage links and attach the conversion logs
End-to-end job has idempotency: re-submitting the same weights returns existing artifact and profile instead of duplicating
tasks: Implement HTTP intake gateway with multipart upload + checksum verification
Wire conversion worker pool to run format detection + convert to runtime-target format
Create tokenizer-parity microservice that runs sample tokenization and reports mapping diffs
Author deterministic smoke test harness (10 canonical prompts) with generation and embedding checks
Add KV-cache replay harness using small prefix corpus and compare token outputs
Integrate with profile-publisher to snapshot perf metrics (p50/p95 latency, memory, tokens/s, quantized size)
Define pinflow: candidate -> QA -> pinned, with database contract and API endpoints
Publish observability: per-job trace id, link to perf dashboard (Grafana), and structured Sentry events
Add rollback and quarantine policy for profiles that fail downstream SSR/QA
Document the flow in Confluence and update onboarding runbook
